author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at a brand new trailer showcasing the latest for Soulframe, including a new Warsongs Fable which features a corrupted player progression path, a fishing mini-game, and the long-anticipated mount system. Soulframe is coming soon to PC (Steam), with the Preludes Early Access for PC available now.
title: Soulframe - Official Warsongs Trailer | TennoCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the trailer for Warframe: Tau, Warframe's next major narrative chapter. Reach beyond the bounds of the Origin System and venture into a new Star Chart, the Tau System. Once a paradise built by the Sentients, Tau has been lost to war and ruin. Nowhere is this felt more keenly than on the black rain-soaked streets of Fornax, a colossal Sentient ring city. Here, the devastating downpour and its maddening influence run in rivulets from the heights of the Hunra's gambling dens, through the Docks, and into the most desperate Slums — where the residents have turned to the mind-altering Bloom in search of escape.
There, Albrecht Entrati awaits the arrival of the Tenno after conscripting the inner monologuing and noir-inspired Warframe, Brysko, to infiltrate the Hunra's criminal underworld — a final gamble to avert Fornax falling to those with nothing to lose. Get ready to risk it all. 
Warframe: Tau arrives later this year.
title: Warframe: Tau - Official Trailer | TennoCon 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the announcement trailer for Stickility, an upcoming 2D Metroidvania developed by Reglan. Explore vast and deep interiors of an underground research center, brimming with creative foes, bosses, NPC's, and more. Craft your equipment from scavenged tech, and uncover Biotec's dark experiments. Stickility will be available soon on PC (Steam).
title: Stickility - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Total War: Warhammer 40,000 shown to players at Bilibili World 2026. In the 41st Millennium, battles rage in every corner of the Galaxy. Forces are in orbit around a civilised world in the Armageddon theatre, under threat by an ongoing invasion of Orks. The governor of this planet has requested aid, and the Astra Militarum have joined the defence.
title: Total War: Warhammer 40,000 - Gameplay Video | BiliBili World 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Yosuke Hanamura sizzle for Persona 4 Revival, a remake of the hit turn-based RPG developed by Atlus. In this sizzle, players can meet Yosuke Hanamura, voiced by Paul Castro Jr. Yosuke Hanamura is rolling into Persona 4 Revival, launching on February 18, 2027, for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).
title: Persona 4 Revival - Official Yosuke Hanamura Sizzle Trailer
